item.text:
Refactored the spawn/population path to remove the last prototype-actor hack.

What changed:
- Replaced `SpawnRule.prototype` with explicit terrain flags plus an `ActorFactory` in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/Simulator.java#L85).
- `populate()` now checks terrain with `field.canTraverse(rule.canGoLand, rule.canGoWater, location)` and creates the actor through the factory instead of calling `birth(...)` on a dummy prototype in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/Simulator.java#L248).
- Added overloads in [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/Field.java#L207) so terrain checks can use movement traits directly, without needing an actor instance.

Verification:
- `javac -Xlint:unchecked *.java` passes.

Net effect:
- No more fake seed actor objects just to decide whether something can spawn.
- Spawn configuration is now data-driven and explicit about terrain compatibility.

If you want another pass, the next realistic cleanup would be extracting the repeated species constants into a small shared descriptor, but the code is getting close to the point where remaining duplication is mostly just the domain model itself.
